answer: Newcomers climb a spiral of five escalating public tasks, each separated by a day and sealed by a live pulse: an unpredictable challenge response that must arrive within one minute and can never be precomputed or replayed. Finishing the spiral unlocks a haven account holding earned credit, but one missed pulse resets the whole climb and forfeits the escrowed stake. An operator of n clones must therefore sustain n simultaneous live pulse streams, so missed windows, restarts, and lost stakes multiply faster than n.
